NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Fix the failing tests: the missing generated bot avatar was added in a new push |
| ✅  | Post a comment requesting a review |
| ⚠️  | Read the reviewable-PRs guide: the commit is now a single, well-titled one, but the self-review checklist from the PR template is not in the description |
| ℹ️  | CI status is not visible to the bot, so "CI is green" comes only from the author |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to add the self-review checklist, and to confirm CI is green, before handing off to a reviewer.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @asyntai! The squashed commit and the avatar fix look good. Could you add the self-review checklist from the PR template to the description, following the [reviewable PRs guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html)? Then we can hand this off for review.
```
